Perfect! I've created a middleware file at `/vercel/sandbox/middleware.ts` that will log every request to the console. Here's what it does:

**Logging details:**
- Timestamp
- HTTP method (GET, POST, etc.)
- Full URL
- User-Agent header
- Client IP address (from x-forwarded-for or x-real-ip headers)

**Matcher configuration:**
The middleware runs on all routes except:
- Next.js static files (`_next/static`)
- Next.js optimized images (`_next/image`)
- favicon.ico

You can test it by running `npm run dev` and visiting any page in your app. The request logs will appear in the console where the dev server is running.
